sources.title: GLiNER: Schema-Conditioned Extraction Model
sources.snippet: GLiNER is a schema-conditioned family of encoder models designed for flexible, natural-language driven extraction and dynamic extension to arbitrary entity types. It reformulates named entity recognition as semantic matching of text spans with descriptive labels, enabling zero-shot performance and reduced retraining needs. Subsequent variants broaden its scope to multitask extraction ...
